_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. Copy to tests/<env>-suite-config.json and replace all <PLACEHOLDERS>. Never commit a file containing real IDs/ARNs. See SPEC.md sections 4A (Validation Strategy), 8 and 9.
_validation_note: Expected prompt text is customer-specific and brittle. Prefer validating on routing EVENTS (action_triggered) and ATTRIBUTES (check) over prompt wording. Prompt-text observations are OPTIONAL; when used, default match=Similarity. See SPEC.md section 4A.

safety._comment: Live-agent and side-effect protections. Keep blockQueueTransfers=true unless you have a deliberate reason. See SPEC.md section 7.

resources._comment: Reusable resource references. Create one always-open and one always-closed hours-of-operation for business-hours/after-hours simulation.

testCases._comment: Example 1 (RECOMMENDED PATTERN) — Validate a DTMF path by the routing EVENT + target, not prompt text. Portable across any contact center. Lambda mocked so the real function is never invoked. Ends before reaching an agent.
testCases.name: menu-option-<n>-routes-to-<destination>
testCases.description: Pressing <n> routes the caller to <destination> (validated by event + attribute)

testCases._comment: Example 2 — Validate a Lambda-integration path by the InvokeLambdaFunction EVENT and a resulting attribute. No prompt text asserted. Lambda mocked.
testCases.name: menu-option-<n>-lambda-lookup
testCases.description: Pressing <n> invokes the data-dip Lambda and sets the expected attribute

testCases._comment: Example 3 — After-hours branch validated by the CheckHoursOfOperation EVENT (hours mocked to OutOfHours). Optional prompt observation shown but commented as customer-specific.
testCases.name: after-hours-routing
testCases.description: Outside business hours, the flow takes the closed branch

testCases._comment: Example 4 (OPTIONAL prompt-text validation) — Only if the customer explicitly wants to assert wording. Prompt text is customer-supplied and match defaults to Similarity (tolerant). Prefer the event-based patterns above where possible.
testCases.name: greeting-wording-check
testCases.description: Validates the greeting wording (customer-provided expected text)

testCases._comment: Example 5 — Queue routing validated SAFELY: observe the transfer event, assert the queue, end immediately. Optionally substitute an agent-free test queue. Never observe events after the contact is enqueued. See SPEC.md section 7.
testCases.name: menu-option-<n>-queue-routing
testCases.description: Pressing <n> transfers to the expected queue (ends before reaching an agent)
